apply_weight_init: apply weight_init to a PyTorch model using model.apply(weight_init) for proper layer initialization
initialize_conv_layers: initialize Conv1d, Conv2d, Conv3d layers with normal or xavier_normal weight initialization
initialize_batchnorm_layers: initialize BatchNorm1d, BatchNorm2d, BatchNorm3d layers with mean=1 std=0.02 weight and zero bias
initialize_rnn_layers: initialize LSTM, LSTMCell, GRU, GRUCell layers with orthogonal weight and normal bias initialization
initialize_linear_embedding_layers: initialize Linear and Embedding layers with xavier_normal weight and normal bias initialization
